"""Official QUANT interval quantiles on globally z-normalized series; no local rescaling."""
import numpy as np
import torch
from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
from sklearn.preprocessing import RobustScaler
from aeon.transformations.collection.interval_based import QUANTTransformer
from experiments.exp449_residual_fn_method_qualification_antigravity.representations_antigravity import make_representation_antigravity
from experiments.exp449_residual_fn_method_qualification_antigravity.local_gap_antigravity import LocalGapModelAntigravity
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.geometry_heads_antigravity import matrix,OASGeometry
torch.set_num_threads(1)
SEED=20260721
QUANT_CAP=512
INTERVAL_DEPTH=6
QUANTILE_DIVISOR=4

def cap_series(rows):
    x=matrix(rows);length=x.shape[1]
    if length<=QUANT_CAP:capped=x
    else:
        target=np.linspace(0.0,1.0,QUANT_CAP);source=np.linspace(0.0,1.0,length)
        capped=np.stack([np.interp(target,source,row) for row in x])
    if not np.isfinite(capped).all():raise ValueError('nonfinite quant series')
    return np.asarray(capped,dtype=np.float32)[:,np.newaxis,:]

class QuantHeads:
    names=('MiniRocket','oas_distance','quant_distance','quant_joint')
    def __init__(self,rows):
        torch.set_num_threads(1)
        x=matrix(rows);n,length=x.shape;self.length=length
        if n<2:raise ValueError('at least two TRAIN rows required')
        self.raw_encoder=make_representation_antigravity('minirocket_local_gap',SEED)
        raw=self.raw_encoder.fit_transform(x)
        self.control=LocalGapModelAntigravity(raw);self.models={};self.fallback=length<3
        if self.fallback:
            scaler=self.control.scaler;scaled=scaler.transform(raw);geometry=OASGeometry(scaled)
            self.models['oas_distance']=(scaler,geometry,geometry.transform(scaled))
            self.quant_encoder=None
            self.diagnostics=dict(fallback=True,quantlength=0,quantfeaturedim=0)
            return
        self.quant_encoder=QUANTTransformer(interval_depth=INTERVAL_DEPTH,quantile_divisor=QUANTILE_DIVISOR)
        collection=cap_series(x)
        quant=np.asarray(self.quant_encoder.fit_transform(collection),dtype=np.float64)
        if quant.ndim!=2 or quant.shape[0]!=n or not np.isfinite(quant).all():raise ValueError('quant features must be finite two-dimensional')
        self.diagnostics=dict(fallback=False,quantlength=int(collection.shape[-1]),quantfeaturedim=int(quant.shape[1]))
        for name,features in zip(self.names[1:],(raw,quant,np.column_stack((raw,quant)))):
            scaler=self.control.scaler if name=='oas_distance' else RobustScaler(quantile_range=(10,90)).fit(features)
            scaled=scaler.transform(features);geometry=OASGeometry(scaled)
            self.models[name]=(scaler,geometry,geometry.transform(scaled))

    def score(self,rows):
        x=matrix(rows)
        if x.shape[1]!=self.length:raise ValueError('query length must equal fit input length')
        raw=self.raw_encoder.transform(x);result=dict(MiniRocket=self.control.score(raw))
        if self.fallback:
            scaler,geometry,reference=self.models['oas_distance']
            d=cdist(geometry.transform(scaler.transform(raw)),reference)
            oas=np.sort(d,axis=1)[:,:min(3,len(reference))].mean(axis=1)
            result['oas_distance']=oas;result['quant_distance']=np.array(oas,copy=True);result['quant_joint']=np.array(oas,copy=True)
        else:
            collection=cap_series(x)
            quant=np.asarray(self.quant_encoder.transform(collection),dtype=np.float64)
            if quant.ndim!=2 or quant.shape[0]!=len(x) or quant.shape[1]!=self.diagnostics['quantfeaturedim'] or not np.isfinite(quant).all():raise ValueError('quant features must be finite two-dimensional')
            for name,features in zip(self.names[1:],(raw,quant,np.column_stack((raw,quant)))):
                scaler,geometry,reference=self.models[name]
                d=cdist(geometry.transform(scaler.transform(features)),reference)
                result[name]=np.sort(d,axis=1)[:,:min(3,len(reference))].mean(axis=1)
        if not all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in result.values()):raise ValueError('nonfinite quant score')
        return result

"""Official QUANT parity, cap-512 fixture, baseline OAS, isolation, fallback."""
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.diagnostics_antigravity import configure_inner_threads_antigravity
configure_inner_threads_antigravity()
import numpy as np
import pytest
from aeon.transformations.collection.interval_based import QUANTTransformer
from experiments.exp504_quant_geometry_antigravity.quant_antigravity import cap_series,QuantHeads,SEED,QUANT_CAP,INTERVAL_DEPTH,QUANTILE_DIVISOR
from experiments.exp449_residual_fn_method_qualification_antigravity.representations_antigravity import make_representation_antigravity
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.geometry_heads_antigravity import PairedHeads

def test_cap_constants_and_official_quant_parity():
    assert SEED==20260721 and QUANT_CAP==512 and INTERVAL_DEPTH==6 and QUANTILE_DIVISOR==4
    assert QuantHeads.names==('MiniRocket','oas_distance','quant_distance','quant_joint')
    rng=np.random.default_rng(504)
    x=rng.normal(size=(6,128));collection=cap_series(x)
    assert collection.shape==(6,1,128) and collection.dtype==np.float32 and np.isfinite(collection).all()
    official=QUANTTransformer(interval_depth=INTERVAL_DEPTH,quantile_divisor=QUANTILE_DIVISOR)
    expected=np.asarray(official.fit_transform(collection),dtype=np.float64)
    assert expected.shape==(6,1160)
    head=QuantHeads(x)
    got=np.asarray(head.quant_encoder.transform(collection),dtype=np.float64)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(got,expected,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    assert head.diagnostics==dict(fallback=False,quantlength=128,quantfeaturedim=1160)
    y=rng.normal(size=(4,777));capped=cap_series(y)
    assert capped.shape==(4,1,512) and capped.dtype==np.float32
    target=np.linspace(0.0,1.0,512);source=np.linspace(0.0,1.0,777)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(capped[0,0],np.interp(target,source,y[0]).astype(np.float32),rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    official512=QUANTTransformer(interval_depth=INTERVAL_DEPTH,quantile_divisor=QUANTILE_DIVISOR)
    expected512=np.asarray(official512.fit_transform(capped),dtype=np.float64)
    assert expected512.shape==(4,4500)
    head512=QuantHeads(y)
    got512=np.asarray(head512.quant_encoder.transform(capped),dtype=np.float64)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(got512,expected512,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    assert head512.diagnostics==dict(fallback=False,quantlength=512,quantfeaturedim=4500)
    assert cap_series(rng.normal(size=(2,2700))).shape==(2,1,512)

def _parity_and_isolation(fit,query):
    head=QuantHeads(fit);scores=head.score(query)
    encoder=make_representation_antigravity('minirocket_local_gap',SEED)
    old=PairedHeads(encoder.fit_transform(fit)).score(encoder.transform(query))
    for name in ('MiniRocket','oas_distance'):np.testing.assert_allclose(scores[name],old[name],rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    before={name:r.copy() for name,(_,_,r) in head.models.items()};single=head.score(query[:1]);head.score(query*4)
    for name in head.names:np.testing.assert_allclose(single[name],scores[name][:1],rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)
    for name,(_,_,reference) in head.models.items():np.testing.assert_array_equal(before[name],reference)
    return head,scores

def test_baseline_raw_oas_isolation_and_n2():
    rng=np.random.default_rng(504);x=rng.normal(size=(12,64));q=rng.normal(size=(5,64))
    for n in (2,12):
        head,scores=_parity_and_isolation(x[:n],q)
        assert head.names==('MiniRocket','oas_distance','quant_distance','quant_joint')
        assert set(scores)==set(head.names)
        assert all(v.shape==(len(q),) and np.isfinite(v).all() for v in scores.values())
        assert head.diagnostics['fallback'] is False
        assert head.diagnostics['quantlength']==64
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):QuantHeads(x).score(q[:,:-1])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):QuantHeads(np.ones((1,64)))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):QuantHeads(np.array([[1.,2.,3.],[np.nan,0.,1.]]))
    bad=q.copy();bad[0,-1]=np.inf
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):QuantHeads(x).score(bad)

def test_short_length_fallback_and_l3():
    rng=np.random.default_rng(504)
    for length in (1,2):
        fit=rng.normal(size=(8,length));query=rng.normal(size=(5,length))
        head,scores=_parity_and_isolation(fit,query)
        assert head.diagnostics==dict(fallback=True,quantlength=0,quantfeaturedim=0)
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(scores['quant_distance'],scores['oas_distance'])
        np.testing.assert_array_equal(scores['quant_joint'],scores['oas_distance'])
        assert head.quant_encoder is None
    fit=rng.normal(size=(8,3));query=rng.normal(size=(5,3))
    head,scores=_parity_and_isolation(fit,query)
    assert head.diagnostics==dict(fallback=False,quantlength=3,quantfeaturedim=10)
    assert head.quant_encoder is not None
    assert all(v.shape==(5,) and np.isfinite(v).all() for v in scores.values())
    collection=cap_series(fit)
    official=QUANTTransformer(interval_depth=INTERVAL_DEPTH,quantile_divisor=QUANTILE_DIVISOR)
    expected=np.asarray(official.fit_transform(collection),dtype=np.float64)
    assert expected.shape==(8,10)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(np.asarray(head.quant_encoder.transform(collection),dtype=np.float64),expected,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8)

"""TRAIN-only proxy screening of the preregistered QUANT geometry grid."""
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.diagnostics_antigravity import configure_inner_threads_antigravity

from contextlib import closing
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor,as_completed
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter
import json,multiprocessing
import numpy as np
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.diagnostics_antigravity import ROOT,DB,SEED,readonly_sqlite_antigravity,write_json_atomic_antigravity,cpu_worker_policy_antigravity,file_sha256_antigravity
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.pilot_antigravity import load_normal_train,perturbations,KINDS
from experiments.exp449_residual_fn_method_qualification_antigravity.scoring_antigravity import crossfit_plan_antigravity
from .quant_antigravity import QuantHeads
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def worker(meta):
    start=perf_counter();folds=[];tails=[];diagnostics=[]
    with closing(readonly_sqlite_antigravity(DB)) as con:x=load_normal_train(con,meta['dataset'])
    assert len(x)==meta['n_train']
    with threadpool_limits(limits=1):
        for fold,(fit,query) in enumerate(crossfit_plan_antigravity(len(x),seed=SEED)):
            assert not np.intersect1d(fit,query).size
            heads=QuantHeads(x[fit])
            diagnostics.append(heads.diagnostics)
            scores=heads.score(x[query]);threshold={k:float(v.max()) for k,v in scores.items()}
            tails.append({k:float((v.max()-np.median(v))/(np.quantile(v,.75)-np.quantile(v,.25)+1e-9)) for k,v in scores.items()})
            values={}
            for kind,proxy in perturbations(x[query],SEED+1709*(fold+1)).items():
                s=heads.score(proxy);values[kind]={k:float(np.mean(v>threshold[k])) for k,v in s.items()}
            folds.append(values)
    return dict(dataset=meta['dataset'],source_family=meta['source_family'],folds=folds,normal_tail_by_fold=tails,diagnostics=diagnostics,seconds=perf_counter()-start)

def main():
    start=perf_counter();result=P/'pilot_results_antigravity.json'
    if result.exists():raise RuntimeError('completed pilot must not be overwritten')
    source=ROOT/'experiments/exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity/diagnostics_manifest_antigravity.json'
    population=json.loads(source.read_text())['population'];assert len(population)==len({r['source_family'] for r in population})==50
    old=json.loads((ROOT/'experiments/exp494_all_datasets_low_fpr_antigravity/run_manifest_antigravity.json').read_text())
    assert file_sha256_antigravity(DB)==old['binding']['source_binding']['database']
    cm=json.loads((ROOT/'docs/codemap/codemap_exp504_antigravity.json').read_text());code={n['path']:n['sha256'] for n in cm['nodes']}
    for path,h in code.items():assert file_sha256_antigravity(ROOT/path)==h
    policy=cpu_worker_policy_antigravity();manifest=dict(state='running',population=population,source_population_sha256=file_sha256_antigravity(source),
        code=code,protocol_sha256=file_sha256_antigravity(P/'protocol_antigravity.html'),database_sha256=file_sha256_antigravity(DB),cpu_policy=policy,
        test_values_read=False,test_labels_read=False,selection_rule='max minimum corruption mean recall, then mean, then frozen candidate order',
        backend='official Torch CPU QUANTTransformer float32 plus official Numba MiniRocket; canonical float64 OAS; full acceleration assessment recorded separately')
    write_json_atomic_antigravity(P/'pilot_manifest_antigravity.json',manifest);records=[]
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=policy['workers'],mp_context=multiprocessing.get_context('spawn')) as pool:
        for future in as_completed([pool.submit(worker,r) for r in population]):
            records.append(future.result());print(json.dumps(dict(completed=len(records),total=len(population))),flush=True)
    summary={name:{kind:float(np.mean([np.mean([fold[kind][name] for fold in r['folds']]) for r in records])) for kind in KINDS} for name in QuantHeads.names}
    tails={n:float(np.median([np.mean([v[n] for v in row['normal_tail_by_fold']]) for row in records])) for n in QuantHeads.names}
    assert all(np.isfinite(v) for v in tails.values())
    eligible=list(QuantHeads.names[:2])+[n for n in QuantHeads.names[2:] if tails[n]<=3*max(tails['MiniRocket'],1e-9)]
    criterion=lambda n:(min(summary[n].values()),np.mean(list(summary[n].values())),-QuantHeads.names.index(n))
    anchor=max(QuantHeads.names[:2],key=criterion);unrestricted=max(eligible,key=criterion);selected=unrestricted
    if unrestricted not in QuantHeads.names[:2] and (min(summary[unrestricted].values())<min(summary[anchor].values())+.02 or np.mean(list(summary[unrestricted].values()))<np.mean(list(summary[anchor].values()))):selected=anchor
    out=dict(state='complete_train_only_pilot',summary=summary,selected=selected,unrestricted_winner=unrestricted,best_anchor=anchor,eligible=eligible,normal_tail=tails,required_proxy_margin=.02,records=sorted(records,key=lambda r:r['dataset']),test_values_read=False,test_labels_read=False,seconds=perf_counter()-start)
    write_json_atomic_antigravity(result,out);manifest.update(state=out['state'],result_sha256=file_sha256_antigravity(result),seconds=out['seconds'])
    write_json_atomic_antigravity(P/'pilot_manifest_antigravity.json',manifest);print(json.dumps({k:out[k] for k in ('selected','summary','seconds')}),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Complete QUANT fit and score benchmark; never rewrite official QUANTTransformer."""
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.diagnostics_antigravity import configure_inner_threads_antigravity
configure_inner_threads_antigravity()
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter
import json
import numpy as np
import aeon,numba,torch
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.diagnostics_antigravity import write_json_atomic_antigravity,file_sha256_antigravity
from experiments.exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity.geometry_heads_antigravity import matrix
from . import quant_antigravity as module
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

@numba.njit(cache=False)
def numba_interp_rows(x,source,target):
    n,length=x.shape;m=target.shape[0]
    out=np.empty((n,m),dtype=np.float64)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(m):
            t=target[j]
            if t<=source[0]:out[i,j]=x[i,0]
            elif t>=source[length-1]:out[i,j]=x[i,length-1]
            else:
                k=0
                while k<length-2 and source[k+1]<t:k+=1
                denom=source[k+1]-source[k]
                frac=0. if denom==0. else (t-source[k])/denom
                out[i,j]=(1.-frac)*x[i,k]+frac*x[i,k+1]
    return out

def numba_cap_series(rows):
    x=matrix(rows);length=x.shape[1]
    if length<=module.QUANT_CAP:capped=np.asarray(x,dtype=np.float32)
    else:
        target=np.linspace(0.0,1.0,module.QUANT_CAP);source=np.linspace(0.0,1.0,length)
        capped=np.asarray(numba_interp_rows(x,source,target),dtype=np.float32)
    if not np.isfinite(capped).all():raise ValueError('nonfinite quant series')
    return capped[:,np.newaxis,:]

def _parity(control,out):
    names=module.QuantHeads.names
    return dict(finite=all(np.isfinite(v).all() for v in out.values()),scores_close=all(np.allclose(control[k],out[k],rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8) for k in names),ranks_equal=all(np.array_equal(np.argsort(control[k],kind='stable'),np.argsort(out[k],kind='stable')) for k in names),candidates_equal=all(np.array_equal(np.flatnonzero(control[k]>np.sort(control[k][:1000])[::-1][j]),np.flatnonzero(out[k]>np.sort(out[k][:1000])[::-1][j])) for k in names for j in (0,1,5,10)))

def main():
    rng=np.random.default_rng(504);x=rng.normal(size=(64,128));q=rng.normal(size=(1024,128));x[-1]=0;q[-1]=0
    records={};original=module.cap_series
    with threadpool_limits(limits=1):
        torch.set_num_threads(1)
        start=perf_counter();head=module.QuantHeads(x);out=head.score(q);elapsed=perf_counter()-start
        repeat=head.score(q)
        record=dict(full_fit_score_seconds_including_first_compile_conversion=elapsed,**_parity(out,repeat),dtype_quant_features='float32',dtype_geometry='float64')
        start=perf_counter();warm=module.QuantHeads(x).score(q);record['full_fit_score_warm_seconds']=perf_counter()-start
        record['warm_scores_close']=all(np.allclose(out[k],warm[k],rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-8) for k in out)
        records['canonical']=record
        x2=rng.normal(size=(64,777));q2=rng.normal(size=(1024,777));x2[-1]=0;q2[-1]=0;control=None
        try:
            for name,fn in (('numpy',original),('numba',numba_cap_series)):
                module.cap_series=fn
                start=perf_counter();head=module.QuantHeads(x2);scored=head.score(q2);elapsed=perf_counter()-start
                if control is None:control=scored
                rec=dict(full_fit_score_seconds_including_first_compile_conversion=elapsed,conversion_max_abs_error=float(np.max(np.abs(fn(q2)-original(q2)))),**_parity(control,scored))
                start=perf_counter();module.QuantHeads(x2).score(q2);rec['full_fit_score_warm_seconds']=perf_counter()-start
                records[name]=rec
        finally:
            module.cap_series=original
    path=P.parent/'exp495_normal_geometry_antigravity/acceleration_antigravity.json';old=json.loads(path.read_text())
    records.update(selected='canonical NumPy cap + official Torch CPU QUANTTransformer float32 + official Numba MiniRocket + float64 OAS CPU',scope='Complete MiniRocket and official QUANT fit/transform, all OAS fits and queries, control and candidate scoring; timings include conversion and JIT warm-up; cap interpolation assessed on 64x777/1024x777 with exact same linspace grid; public Torch QUANT is not rewritten',dtype=dict(quant_features='float32',geometry='float64'),versions={'aeon':aeon.__version__,'torch':torch.__version__,'numba':numba.__version__,'mlx':old['mlx'],'mlx-metal':old.get('mlx-metal',old['mps'])},mlx=old['mlx'],mps=old['mps'],availability=old['availability'],inherited_float64_oas_probe=True,inherited_gpu_probe_sha256=file_sha256_antigravity(path),source_sha256=file_sha256_antigravity(Path(__file__)),decision='Official QUANTTransformer is public Torch CPU float32 hardcoded to CPU tensors and cannot be Numba-replaced without rewriting the official transform. GPU is unsupported because the public API is hardcoded to CPU/numpy, not because float32 cannot run on GPU. Extra cap interpolation is Numba-eligible on the same linspace grid but must pass complete-stage parity/speed; canonical NumPy is retained unless full parity and speed are proven. float64 OAS GPU unavailable (inherited Exp495 probe); CPU remains canonical. MiniRocket remains official Numba.')
    write_json_atomic_antigravity(P/'acceleration_results_antigravity.json',records);print(json.dumps({k:records[k] for k in ('canonical','numpy','numba','selected') if k in records}))

files.protocol_antigravity.html:
Exp504 QUANT 기하 이상탐지

가설. 공식 QUANT는 원시계열, 평활 1차차분, 2차차분, FFT 진폭의 다중 척도·이동 구간 분위수로 MiniRocket PPV가 담지 못하는 분포와 진폭을 포착한다는 가설을 둔다. 지도 분류기는 쓰지 않고 정상 표본만으로 OAS 3NN에 연결한다. 공개 구현은 Torch CPU float32이며 재구현하거나 GPU로 옮기지 않는다.

모델. 입력은 기존 전처리로 행별 전역 z-정규화된 시계열이다. 원시 대조는 make_representation_antigravity('minirocket_local_gap', 20260721)의 4032 PPV와 LocalGap, RobustScaler 10-90, 잔차 OAS이다. QUANT 입력은 L이 512 이하면 길이를 보존하고, 512를 넘으면 학습 전에 각 행에 np.interp(linspace(0,1,512), linspace(0,1,L), row)만 적용한다. 추가 z나 클리핑은 없다. 512 상한은 학습 전 계산 한도이며 특징 차원을 약 4500으로 묶는다. 유한 float32 배열 (n, 1, min(L, 512))을 QUANTTransformer(interval_depth=6, quantile_divisor=4)에 넣고 정상 폴드에만 fit한 뒤 질의는 transform한다. 공식 float32 출력을 float64로 캐스팅해 기하에 쓴다.

QuantHeads는 MiniRocket, oas_distance, quant_distance, quant_joint 순서로 점수를 낸다. quant_distance는 QUANT 단독, quant_joint는 4032와 QUANT를 잇는다. 후보마다 자체 RobustScaler 10-90과 기존 잔차 OASGeometry를 적용하고 참조까지 min(3, n) 평균 유클리드 거리를 쓴다. raw OAS만 대조 스케일러를 재사용한다. 가중치, 데이터셋별 선택, TEST 적합은 없다. 표본 수가 1이면 적합 전에 실패한다. L이 3 미만이면 신규 후보는 raw OAS와 같고 진단만 남긴다. 질의 길이는 적합 길이와 같아야 한다. 참조 상한 1000과 시드는 이후 전체 러너가 적용한다.

선택. 파일럿은 Exp495 매니페스트의 메타데이터 가족 50개와 5겹, 적합 폴드만 사용한다. 오염 시드는 SEED+1709*(fold+1)이고 임계값은 보류 정상 점수의 최댓값이다. 신규 후보의 정상 꼬리 중앙값이 MiniRocket의 3배를 넘으면 제외한다. 1순위는 오염 종류별 가족 평균의 최솟값, 2순위는 평균, 동점이면 앞선 이름이다. 신규 후보는 최악 유형에서 최선 Mini/OAS보다 0.02 이상 높고 평균이 앵커 이상이어야 하며 그렇지 않으면 앵커를 고른다. TRAIN 파일럿은 TEST 값을 읽지 않는다.

목표와 동결. 같은 1117 데이터셋, 128 가족에서 경험적 FPR 0.1% 이하, 가족 매크로 TPR MiniRocket 대비 상대 10% 이상, FP0 비회귀가 고정 목표이다. 예산 4개와 평균 3개를 모두 보고한다. 나머지 지표는 보고만 하며 모두 개선될 필요는 없다. 모든 점수와 해시는 TEST 라벨을 보기 전에 동결한다. 이 벤치마크는 개발에 노출되어 있으며 미공개 홀드아웃이 아니다. 인과를 주장하거나 TEST로 튜닝하지 않는다. 이전 TRAIN 관찰은 원인이 아니다. OAS 최악형 0.652220과 중심제곱 joint 0.682594는 게이트를 통과했고 공간 quarter MiniRocket joint 0.639677은 실패했다.

review: Cap-512 is a pre-TRAIN compute bound that distorts long series. QUANT float32 plus OAS float64 on ~4500-d features with small n yields heavy shrinkage. Public Torch QUANT cannot be Numba/GPU-accelerated without rewrite (API is CPU-hardcoded, not a float32 GPU limit). L<3 copies raw OAS so the hypothesis is untested there. Pilot 50-family proxy can diverge from the 128-family goal; do not treat selection as TEST-tuned.
